findings.description: Several dark olives in the jar are rendered as elongated vertical capsule/bar shapes rather than round olives. These deformed pieces persist and multiply through the rest of the clip (clearly visible at 00:01.5, 00:03.0, and 00:08.6), inconsistent with the round olives being poured.

The oven door changes from a solid white panel with a handle (00:00-00:05) to a door with a large dark glass window, and the control panel changes from a single row of knobs to 6 knobs flanking a central digital display. A camera angle shift cannot turn a solid door into a windowed one.

The metal bowl initially contains only green olives. After the person's hand interacts with it around 00:05.1, the bowl (visible from 00:05.6 onward) contains several brown/tan oval objects alongside the olives, with no shown action that would place them there.

The olives visible in the source jar and the olive seen falling at 00:00.0 are all green, but the first olive resting at the bottom of the large jar at 00:00.5 is dark purple/black. The color change is not explained by anything visible in frame.
